notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
The game is still under development! I've been posting all my updates on discord and the steam play test.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1750520/eventcomments/

For anyone interested in playing the game and found out the servers are offline, feel free to message me on discord. I'd be happy to turn on the servers whenever people want to play. I just usually keep them off to save money.

Discord: https://discord.gg/DNyAMePSAS

Thanks!
